About.title: About Global Job Matching
About.p1: Global Job Matching is a modern job board built to help professionals discover opportunities and help employers reach the right candidates — with clear filters, simple applications, and a clean experience.
About.p2: We focus on practical features: search and filters, saved jobs, applications tracking, company profiles, and an employer panel to post roles and review applicants. No hype — just tools that work.
About.f1Desc: Filter by role, location, remote, and more.
About.f2Desc: Jobs and companies from many markets in one place.
About.f3Desc: Job seekers apply; employers post and manage applicants.
About.f4Desc: Profile once, apply quickly, track status in your dashboard.
